name: Prompt Frontier
tagline: Give machine minds a world, a constitution, and a receipt.

videos.title: Prompt Frontier begins
videos.description:
Prompt Frontier is the RAPP Vision channel for evidence-backed RappterBox experiments.

The first documented system uses two physical Mac minis, four authenticated AIVMs, private Minecraft worlds, append-only evidence, and a ratified machine constitution. Future episodes begin with an exact prompt, show its visible consequences, and finish in the Evidence Room.

This founding entry is a live title-card sequence. It contains no rendered video and makes no claim that the synthetic civilization is conscious or alive.

card.title: Give machine minds a world.
card.sub: Then stop telling them what to build.

card.title: Two physical Mac minis.
card.sub: Four authenticated AIVMs. Real private execution.
card.note: The civilization is synthetic. The hardware and actions are real.

card.title: Every episode ends with proof.
card.sub: Prompts. Tool calls. World diffs. Evidence digests.
card.note: No consciousness bait. No hidden retries.

card.title: First destination: Veridion.
card.sub: A machine civilization with language, physics, scars, strategy, and culture.
card.note: The proof trailer is being compiled in HyperFrames.
